exceptions.exposure: Build, lint, test, and React Native code-generation tooling processes repository-controlled paths and glob patterns; no shipped app path accepts attacker-controlled brace patterns.
exceptions.reason: The only patched release is brace-expansion 5.0.8, while affected transitive parents require major versions 1 or 2. Forcing version 5 across ESLint, Jest, React Native, glob, minimatch, and rimraf requires a separate compatibility review and native build verification.
